ModMetaData.name: Dominion
ModMetaData.author: Ketschbopp
ModMetaData.description:
A geopolitical simulation that overhauls factions and diplomacy. It adds dynamic news, real diplomacy with physical summits and a Rim Council, espionage and special operations, wars with real warbands, vassalage, economic warfare, culture and influence, and a unification ending.
Dominion ties many mods into one connected world. Economics & Demography and Faction Territories and Vassalage are required. It also connects with Vanilla Outposts Expanded, Visit Settlements, Simple Leadership, RimToll, RimCourt, RimMarket, InterRim Ballistic Missile, Custom Base Framework, Vanilla Books Expanded and Pillage & Plunder when they are installed.
Dominion replaces The News and is not compatible with it.
Early development (M0: framework).
